title: Jeonbuk Bank says an attack using an AI agent leaked credit information of 467 people
date_note: Money Today says the attack came on 24 November and the bank reported it to regulators on 25 November.
summary: Money Today reports that Jeonbuk Bank was hit on 24 November by a hacking attack using an AI agent, leaking account numbers, phone numbers and emails of 467 people, of whom 462 were customers and 5 employees. The bank blocked the attacking IP 20 minutes after detecting it and reported to the financial regulators on 25 November. A bank official said the leaked data had no critical information, so identifying customers is limited.
plain: Money Today reports that an AI-agent attack on Jeonbuk Bank leaked account numbers, phone numbers and emails of 467 people. A bank official said the data had no critical information.
exec: Jeonbuk Bank reported a leak of credit information of 467 people to the regulators on 25 November, Money Today reports.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Money Today says the bank will notify affected customers and take steps to prevent recurrence.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source; city not stated

sources.name: Money Today: 전북은행도 AI에이전트 해킹에 당했다…467건 정보유출

evidence.quote: 전북은행은 지난 24일 오후 AI에이전트를 활용한 해킹 공격을 받아 467명의 계좌번호, 전화번호, 이메일 등 신용정보가 유출됐다.
피해자 467명 가운데 고객 수는 462명, 직원 수는 5명이다.
전북은행은 공격을 감지한 지 20분 만에 공격 IP를 차단하고 익일인 25일 금융감독원, 금융위원회에 정보유출 사실을 보고했다.

validation.note: Only Money Today read; it quotes a bank official. The bank's own notice and the regulators' pages were not read.

review.note: Compared title, 24 Nov date, 467/462/5, 20 minutes, 25 Nov report and bank official statement against Money Today
